suggested_intro: Set up the observation space you will revisit throughout the course.
Apply the roadmap approach to your own region: choose a hazard, examine local evidence, judge the certainty, and decide what it could mean for your garden.
Spend 10 minutes noticing the variety of living things in your observation space.
Compare two areas and record signs of soil condition and soil life.
Observe how water moves, collects, and affects plants in your observation space.
Use evidence from your journal to choose one manageable adaptation.
Review your observations and create a plan for continuing to notice change.
Review the checklist patterns recorded throughout the course.
